questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Having the opportunity to go to a good university and interest in learning the culture of the country.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I think it was easy to find all informartion you just had to be up to date with dadlines and so on.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I had some questions but they were answered by my student counsellor from UCPH.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: I got the information a needed upon arrival and if not i found it on their website. My host university's (Yonsei University) website was a bit complicated.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I would recommend to start looking for a place to live early a lot was already booked when i started looking. I found housing through Airbnb.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: In South Korea the living staandards are not the same as in Denmark so the apartments are not the same quality.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I did not use the housing available to students.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: You have to read information about how to register for the course cause it can be a bit confusion as they have different systems. But i was satisfied as I got all the courses I applied for.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It is a bidding system where you have a number of tokens you have to bid on the courses you want.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The website and you can write an e-mail to the instituion if you have questions about the process. I did not,

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very succesful as i got all the classes i wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I did register for a course that was really hard, so make sure to carefully read all info about the courses before registering,

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The academic level was good but the korean uni culture is very different. You do have quite a big workload throughout the semester.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took introduction courses and the level was high but not too bad.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I only had classroom teaching and not lectures in a lecture hall. In all my classes the students were expected to participate. I korea you have to hand in a lot of small assignments and do presentations.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Introduction to AI as practical tools
Introduction to AI and its applications
Media Communication in Korea
Cyber security 
Brain, Cognition and daily life

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend Media communication in Korea as you learn a lot about the korean culture and history. Introduction to AI and its application was an online class and very interesting if you're interested in how AI works without to much math. AI as practical tools was also interesting it was a course on how to use AI and AI and psychology.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Everyone have to get a Alien registration card I did not now before

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: It is quite expensive to go to the super market so I ate all my meals in restaurants.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: There were a lot of opportunities both sport, additional lectures, clubs etc. Almost every day there were tents of foodtrucks on campus with people telling about their clubs.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: A lot of sports (soccer, basketball, dance etc.) but also a track field you can use for running or a gym you can get a membership at.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend the gym membership and also just the events at Yonsei - there is a lot.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I went on a lot of weekend trips to see more of South Korea not just Seoul. I would also recommend going to the museums (there is a lot) and also just explore all the neighbourhoods in Seoul it is a very diverse city.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Seoul is so big and very overstimulating but also so nice and very efficient. It did not take a lot of time for me to feel at home.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Go to events and be open. The koreans are really shy.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The people are very sweet bu very different. They are so shy and group work can be hard.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The food is amazing.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. check all deadlines
2. explore a lot
3. talk to new people

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember you have to get an Alien Registration Card, I would book a timeslot to go get it before going to Korea because it is a very slow process.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Trying to live in a very different culture.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Being so far from home and being in such a different timezone also missed my own bed (their beds and bedding are not the best...)

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
